checkpoint: P7E explicit caller context wiring into normal agent loop
purpose: Validate that normal runTask can consume explicit caller-owned visual fallback context after semantic planning without inferring document identity from the GUI. The initial supported caller context is bounded to a Pulsar document path and may materialize only the physically validated UTF-8 encoding-selector contract from P7D. No physical UI behavior is claimed by this session.
requiredClaims: without visualFallbackCallerContext or explicit visualFallbackContracts, runTask resolves no visual fallback knowledge
the initial explicit caller-context kind is bounded to pulsar-document and requires a caller-supplied absolute documentPath
runTask itself contains no documentPath-specific logic; the path is interpreted only by the dedicated caller-context/materializer modules outside the planner
a valid pulsar-document context plus semantic Pulsar + OPEN UTF-8 plan materializes exactly one P7D execution contract
wrong application or wrong OPEN target materializes no contract
relative/invalid paths and unsupported caller-context kinds fail closed with recoveryPolicy NONE
supplying both explicit contracts and caller context is ambiguous and fails closed
the materialized contract keeps exact target, exact window-title surface precondition, exact UTF-16 LE postcondition and local text-region provider requirements
no coordinates or concrete perception provider identity are introduced
caller-context resolution happens after semantic planning but before the intent execution loop
planner source remains free of caller context, scope, visual fallback, postcondition, provider request and coordinates
caller-context/materializer modules do not invoke Computer Control, perception provider selection or visual action execution
P5A-P6D and P7D regression contracts still pass
Computer Use and Computer Control product trees remain clean
nonClaims: This session is contract-only and does not claim physical Pulsar behavior.
This session does not add a generic Pulsar status-bar capability.
This session does not auto-discover a document path from foreground state, semantic snapshots, window titles or filesystem heuristics.
This session does not select a perception provider; provider selection remains lazy after a P5B-eligible semantic gap.
This session does not claim success from CLICK_POSTED; physical success semantics remain those established by P7C.
This session does not add JavaScript, LF, Spaces: 2, arbitrary encoding actions, or arbitrary Pulsar visual targets.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose exact product/test defect, fix forward and create s02.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: No screenshot bytes, OCR payload, target coordinates, action coordinates or real user document paths are required by this contract-only session.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P7E physical validation through normal runTask using only explicit visualFallbackCallerContext {kind:pulsar-document, documentPath}, with no injected visualFallbackContracts
